title: Syndax Announces Participation in September Investor Conferences
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Syndax Pharmaceuticals, Inc.'s business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
NEW YORK, Sept. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Syndax Pharmaceuticals (Nasdaq: SNDX), a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company advancing innovative cancer therapies, today announced that Michael A. Metzger, Chief Executive Officer, as well as members of the Syndax management team, will participate in the following upcoming investor conferences:


- **Citi 2026 Biopharma Back to School Conference** in New York, NY with a fireside chat on Thursday, September 10, 2026, at 8:40 a.m. ET.
- **H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference** in New York, NY with a fireside chat on Tuesday, September 15, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. ET.


A live webcast of the fireside chats will be available in the Investor section of the Company's website at[www.syndax.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=mShiWaqMm7X7QrqpEWWTY6XST7Is2_E5JpKWl61PQHUFoK7vE_wmu4zABzZv8JN-Kc0UU21pPINEqGXPWbjcOQ==) , where a replay will also be available for a limited time.


**About Syndax**


Syndax Pharmaceuticals is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company advancing innovative cancer therapies. Highlights of the Company's pipeline include Revuforj® (revumenib), an FDA-approved menin inhibitor, and Niktimvo™ (axatilimab-csfr), an FDA-approved monoclonal antibody that blocks the colony stimulating factor 1 (CSF-1) receptor. Fueled by our commitment to reimagining cancer care, Syndax is working to unlock the full potential of its pipeline and is conducting several clinical trials across the continuum of treatment. For more information, please visit[www.syndax.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=mShiWaqMm7X7QrqpEWWTYykHdWb6lYtIgQjJH9yJp3-MSINOonlIcr16JgNMENHP1wD488KGA8JcrjyZ3vJWow==) or follow the Company on[X](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=6z6edcyC2fLpybXhLWns0MnlGL9W4LMnJN5ty3WWSTgVFmkIjECqNoNfpBN0WZ9C4j01wk8muIhnsk1JpCGS3w==) and[LinkedIn](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=0ZtN00KnAYivvs4K32EnYDpk3sHjOXWXnpGguQnvUAOXDRx7Loj40OReFVGHAddOKKIaPA116_GZ1Qr0s7UGRLhHKwL-7_1EXPMe0TMDCZw6_U7NxGyPSQceEBT8sQD3) .
